The issuer shows a very strong balance sheet, with equity funding about 60% of assets, moderate leverage, a solid current ratio near 1.3x, and exceptionally strong operating profitability (EBIT of about 46% of revenue). These metrics are consistent with a high-grade, low-credit-risk profile, though without more detail on debt structure and cash flow coverage I would stop short of the very top tier.

DECISION: AA+
